cohort: The study included 952 children aged 3-12 years in Basrah, Iraq, comprising 407 asthmatic cases and 545 age-matched non-asthmatic controls.
finding: Delivery via Caesarean section was found to be an independent significant risk factor for asthma.
mod_finding: Caesarean section is significantly associated with an increased risk of childhood asthma (OR=3.37; 95% CI=1.76-6.46; p<0.001).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was identified as a significant predictor of asthma (OR=16.7).
